screen.worldlogic_thermal.title: Thermal
message.worldlogic_thermal.fiber_ready: Ready. Strike again to collect fiber.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.stone: Right-click a lit campfire or furnace
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.pouch: Heat at a lit stove or cool on ice
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.charcoal: Heat at a lit stove with coal in the offhand
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.fan: Right-click in air to fan yourself
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.flask: Heat at a lit stove or cool on ice
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.body: Internal body temperature. Too high or low causes illness and reduced performance.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.air: Outside air temperature at your location, before your clothing and local heat sources.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.felt: What the body is exposed to after wind, wetness, heat and cooling.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.wet: How wet your body is. Wetness accelerates cooling and reduces insulation.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.insulati: Clothing protection against cold. Excess insulation can worsen heat.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.heat: Immediate warmth from nearby sources and portable heating.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.trend: Expected body temperature change per minute at the present conditions.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.adaptati: Cold and heat tolerance. Long moderate exposure builds separate adaptation; it fades away from that climate. Up to 3°C of stress compensation.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.nutritio: Food and saturation reserve. Low nutrition makes it harder to stay warm; meals give brief metabolic support.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.room_hea: Slowly retained warmth or cooling in a bounded enclosed room. Open spaces do not store this bonus.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.conditio: Acute temperature illness. Local frostbite is recorded by Trauma, when installed.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.biome: The local biome. Its climate influences normal air conditions.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.elevatio: Height relative to sea level; altitude can influence climate.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.humidity: Relative humidity. Moist air slows evaporation and drying.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.wind: Estimated outdoor wind; shelter and clothing reduce its effect.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.precip: Precipitation and intensity. Rain wets exposed skin.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.solar: Direct solar exposure. Shade reduces heat and sunstroke risk.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.referenc: Approximate climate baseline when the core supports the older calculation. Not an annual mean.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.daily: Approximate clear-day range, unavailable for the newer weather model.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.annual: Yearly climate model is not implemented by Temperature; the core owns seasons.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.shelter: No direct view of the sky. A roof alone does not guarantee a warm room.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.history_: Saved measurements along your route; use arrows to change day.
Air, perceived and body temperature of the selected observation.
Time, coordinates, biome and dimension of the selected measurement.
Number of measurements recorded on this game day.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.weather_: Current local weather supplied by the core. Rain and wind change heat exposure.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.pressure: Modeled atmospheric pressure. Display only; it is not a second temperature modifier.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.info.gust: Short bursts of stronger wind. In exposed locations they increase cooling.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.cycle_seconds: Active time: %s s per charge or batch
block.worldlogic_thermal.clay_hearth.inf: Heats nearby and stores warmth in enclosed rooms. Right-click with coal.
block.worldlogic_thermal.evaporative_coo: Cools warm air by evaporation, best in a dry shelter. Right-click with a water bucket.
block.worldlogic_thermal.oil_lamp.info: Light and mild warmth. Right-click with plant oil.
block.worldlogic_thermal.clay_brazier.in: Local heat source. Right-click with coal.
block.worldlogic_thermal.stone_stove.inf: Heating with residual warmth after fuel burns out. Right-click with coal.
block.worldlogic_thermal.brick_fireplace: Strong heat source with residual warmth. Right-click with coal.
block.worldlogic_thermal.evaporative_wal: Evaporative cooling; humid air reduces effect. Right-click with a water bucket.
block.worldlogic_thermal.ice_cooler.info: Right-click with ice, packed ice or blue ice. Cools above 24 °C regardless of humidity.
block.worldlogic_thermal.wind_tower.info: Passively cools in hot weather with wind and open sky above the tower.
block.worldlogic_thermal.chimney.info: Place above a climate heater. An open outlet increases heat output by 15%.
Right-click to toggle. Closed beside a climate heater, reduces its output by 55%.
block.worldlogic_thermal.woven_canopy.in: Shade beneath the canopy: removes direct solar exposure up to 8 blocks below. Not an enclosed room.
block.worldlogic_thermal.textile_loom.in: Right-click with thread; collect woven fabric with an empty hand.
block.worldlogic_thermal.drying_rack.inf: Right-click with charged wet cloth; collect after drying.
block.worldlogic_thermal.hide_frame.info: Right-click with leather; collect prepared hide with an empty hand.
block.worldlogic_thermal.felting_board.i: Right-click with combed wool; collect felt with an empty hand.
item.worldlogic_thermal.raw_fiber_bundle: Raw material for processing on stone with a scraper.
item.worldlogic_thermal.woven_fiber.info: Woven fabric for clothing and canopies.
item.worldlogic_thermal.stone_scraper.in: Scrapes plant material on the work surface.
item.worldlogic_thermal.spindle.info: Right-click: 2 dry fibers in offhand → 4 thread.
item.worldlogic_thermal.bone_needle.info: Right-click with damaged garment in offhand and 1 thread; repairs 25% durability.
item.worldlogic_thermal.wool_comb.info: Right-click: 1 wool block in offhand → 2 combed wool.
tooltip.worldlogic_thermal.emi_hint: In-world usage, not a crafting-grid recipe.
